title: SHOPIFY_STORE_URL env resolution (digital-product pilot)
description: Result of reading SHOPIFY_STORE_URL. Unset or blank is a no-op: the mandate/Done path does not require a storefront. A set value is validated as https with no userinfo and is never fetched. This is operator env, not a mandate field — store_url on the signed document remains rejected.

ok.description: false only when the env is set and the value is not a usable https URL.

enabled.description: true only when a valid https store URL is configured. Never implies a live call.

store_url.description: Trimmed https URL when configured; otherwise null. Invalid values are not echoed.
